import time, random, math

def solve(instance):
    n=instance['n']; edges=instance['edges']
    adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]; deg=[0]*n
    for u,v,w in edges:
        adj[u].append((v,w)); adj[v].append((u,w)); deg[u]+=w; deg[v]+=w
    seed=(n*9176+sum((u+1)*(v+3)*w for u,v,w in edges))&0xffffffff
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    start=time.process_time(); deadline=start+1.42
    best=None; bestval=-1
    # Local improvement from a starting assignment, steepest positive flips
    def improve(x):
        nonlocal best,bestval
        gains=[0]*n
        for i in range(n):
            s=0
            for j,w in adj[i]: s += w if x[i]==x[j] else -w
            gains[i]=s
        while True:
            v=max(range(n),key=gains.__getitem__)
            if gains[v]<=0: break
            old=x[v]; x[v]=1-old
            for j,w in adj[v]: gains[j] += (-2*w if x[j]==old else 2*w)
            gains[v]=-gains[v]
        val=sum(w for u,v,w in edges if x[u]!=x[v])
        if val>bestval: bestval=val; best=x[:]
    order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i:deg[i],reverse=True)
    it=0
    while time.process_time()<deadline:
        it+=1
        typ=it%4
        if typ==0:
            x=[rng.randrange(2) for _ in range(n)]
        else:
            # randomized greedy assignment
            if typ==1:
                order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i: deg[i]*(0.8+0.4*rng.random()),reverse=True)
            elif typ==2:
                order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i: deg[i]+rng.random()*25,reverse=True)
            else:
                order=list(range(n)); rng.shuffle(order)
            x=[-1]*n
            assigned=[]
            for v in order:
                a=b=0
                for j,w in adj[v]:
                    if x[j]==0: a+=w
                    elif x[j]==1: b+=w
                # probability weighted towards locally best side; side gain cross is opposing same-side weight
                d=a-b
                temp=3.0 if typ==1 else 6.0
                if rng.random() < 1/(1+math.exp(max(-30,min(30,d/temp)))): x[v]=0
                else: x[v]=1
            # x currently construction picks side0 probability sigmoid((b-a)/temp), correct preference side0 when b > a
        improve(x)
    return best

        for i in range(n):
            s=0
            for j,w in adj[i]: s += w if x[i]==x[j] else -w
            gains[i]=s
        while True:
            v=max(range(n),key=gains.__getitem__)
            if gains[v]<=0: break
            old=x[v]; x[v]=1-old
            for j,w in adj[v]: gains[j] += (-2*w if x[j]==old else 2*w)
            gains[v]=-gains[v]
        val=sum(w for u,v,w in edges if x[u]!=x[v])
        if val>bestval: bestval=val; best=x[:]
    order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i:deg[i],reverse=True)
    it=0
    while time.process_time()<deadline:
        it+=1
        typ=it%4
        if typ==0:
            x=[rng.randrange(2) for _ in range(n)]
        else:
            # randomized greedy assignment
            if typ==1:
                order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i: deg[i]*(0.8+0.4*rng.random()),reverse=True)
            elif typ==2:
                order=sorted(range(n),key=lambda i: deg[i]+rng.random()*25,reverse=True)
            else:
                order=list(range(n)); rng.shuffle(order)
            x=[-1]*n
            assigned=[]
            for v in order:
                a=b=0
                for j,w in adj[v]:
                    if x[j]==0: a+=w
                    elif x[j]==1: b+=w
                # probability weighted towards locally best side; side gain cross is opposing same-side weight
                d=a-b
                temp=3.0 if typ==1 else 6.0
                if rng.random() < 1/(1+math.exp(max(-30,min(30,d/temp)))): x[v]=0
